name: @nightraze/crazygame
description: The CrazyGames build. Uploaded to their developer portal and served from their CDN, so it is a standalone copy of the game client rather than a second entry point of client/ — see README.md for what that costs and how to keep the two in step.

scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../nightraze-crazygames.zip . && cd .. && echo "built nightraze-crazygames.zip"
